items.title: 70980_Quinn Wilson oral history interview
items.q: I stayed with Bernie Young, oh, I guess for about -- almost a year.

ctx.x: Well, how long were you with that band?

I stayed with that band about six months. Then I left and gigged around Chicago for a little while, and then I went back with Art Simms. When I went back with Art Simms is when he died. And I stayed with Bernie Young, oh, I guess for about -- almost a year.
Did you go with Erskine Tate after Bernie Young?
